entities.summary: Dominika Misterska-Zasowska is a Polish weightlifter. She won a silver medal for the middleweight division at the 2005 European Weightlifting Championships in Sofia, Bulgaria, and bronze at the 2006 European Weightlifting Championships in Władysławowo, Poland.
